module-title.purpose: Compact Engine, Evaluation history, Coach, and Moves headings.

control.purpose: Shared button, input, and select scale.

numeric-detail.purpose: Accuracy and other compact supporting data.

shadows.name: last-move
shadows.purpose: Marks the recorded move's origin and destination squares.

motion.name: button-colors
motion.purpose: Shared button feedback. Disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Find games
components.description: Brass primary action for public-game discovery.
components.css: .ds-primary { font: 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; background: var(--accent, #e9c67d); color: var(--accent-text, #1e180e); border: 1px solid transparent; padding-inline: 22px; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #f6e4aa; } .ds-primary:active { background: #d9b854; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #e9c67d); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Settings trigger
components.description: Raised charcoal action within the Engine module.
components.css: .ds-secondary { font: 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; background: var(--surface-raised, #262626); color: var(--text, #f4f4f4); border: 1px solid var(--line, #343434); } .ds-secondary:hover { background: #373737; } .ds-secondary:active { background: #373737; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #e9c67d); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-secondary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Username field
components.description: A visible label above an inset field.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; font: 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #f4f4f4); } .ds-field input { box-sizing: border-box; font: 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #535353; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--inset, #111111); color: inherit; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #899595; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #e9c67d); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Back to library
components.description: The return action at the start of the review header.
components.css: .ds-back { font: 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; background: var(--surface-raised, #262626); color: var(--text, #f4f4f4); border: 1px solid var(--line, #343434); } .ds-back:hover { background: #373737; } .ds-back:active { background: #373737; } .ds-back:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #e9c67d); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-back { transition: none; } }

components.name: Evaluation history
components.description: Inset plot with a gold selected-ply marker and a focusable range control.
components.html: Evaluation history
components.css: .ds-graph { background: var(--panel, #171717); color: var(--text, #f4f4f4); border: 1px solid var(--line, #343434); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; } .ds-graph h2 { font: 700 15px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0; } .ds-track { position: relative; margin-top: 6px; } .ds-track svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 44px; background: var(--inset, #111111); } .ds-track input { position: absolute; inset: 0; appearance: none; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0; margin: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; cursor: crosshair; background: transparent; } .ds-track input::-webkit-slider-thumb { appearance: none; width: 12px; height: 26px; background: transparent; } .ds-track input::-moz-range-thumb { width: 12px; height: 26px; border: 0; background: transparent; } .ds-track input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #e9c67d); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Paired moves
components.description: Full-move rows pair White and Black SAN and show the current ply in brass.
components.css: .ds-moves { background: var(--panel, #171717); color: var(--text, #f4f4f4); border: 1px solid var(--line, #343434); border-radius: 12px; font: 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-moves h2 { font-size: 15px; margin: 0; } .ds-move-columns, .ds-moves li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3ch repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; align-items: center; } .ds-move-columns { margin-top: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; color: var(--text-secondary, #b6b6b6); font-size: 12px; } .ds-moves ol { border: 1px solid var(--line, #343434); border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px; margin: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-moves li { padding: 2px 4px; } .ds-moves li:nth-child(odd) { background: var(--inset, #111111); } .ds-moves button { font: 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; color: inherit; font-weight: 400; } .ds-moves button:not([aria-current]):hover { background: var(--surface-raised, #262626); } .ds-moves button[aria-current=step] { background: var(--accent, #e9c67d); color: var(--accent-text, #1e180e); border: 1px solid transparent; font-weight: 700; } .ds-moves button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #e9c67d); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-moves button { transition: none; } }

components.name: Engine module
components.description: A flat panel with a depth readout and ranked lines divided by thin rules.
components.css: .ds-engine { background: var(--panel, #171717); color: var(--text, #f4f4f4); border: 1px solid var(--line, #343434); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; font: 13px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-engine header { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-engine h2 { font-size: 15px; margin: 0; } .ds-engine header span { color: var(--text-secondary, #b6b6b6); font-size: 12px; } .ds-engine ol { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 4px 0; } .ds-engine li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 6ch minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; padding: 4px 6px; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-engine li + li { border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #343434); } .ds-engine strong { color: var(--accent, #e9c67d); }

narrative.overview: The warm chessboard anchors a compact black and charcoal workbench. Distinct modules make engine evidence, evaluation history, coaching, and paired notation easy to scan alongside the position. Brass draws attention to the current move and primary actions.
keyCharacteristics: Tan and cream squares with locally served Merida pieces.
Flat black and charcoal panels with restrained brass selection.
Inter Variable with tabular scores and move numbers.
A graph that also serves as the position scrubber.
dos: Use brass for the current move, primary actions, and keyboard focus.
Keep each game in a divided library row and each chess move in its color column.
Use the evaluation graph itself for scrubbing and preserve visible replay controls.
Keep the coach note primary and voice playback user-initiated.
